Telemetry_Info_Message:
This feature sends anonymous data to help improve RagnaKontroll:

• App version and operating system
• Crash reports with stack traces
• Basic usage statistics (no personal data)

Nej sensitive information like usernames, passwords, or game progress is collected.

Data is sent via Discord Webhook for easy monitoring.

Tut.1_Desc: Welcome to RagnaKontroll! This tutorial will help you get started.
Tut_2_Desc: Tired of missing tiny items? When you open your inventory, use the D-Korsa to snap the cursor perfectly from slot to slot. Tryck 'A' to double-click and equip items instantly.
Tut_3_Desc: Casting Storm Gust has never been easier. Håll down your skill button (e.g., L1+A). The targeting circle appears. Aim with the right stick. Simply RELEASE the button to cast the spell!
Tut_4_Desc: Having trouble clicking on a fast-moving Poring? Just tilt the Höger Stick slightly towards the monster and click R3. The engine will fire a micro-spiral click, guaranteeing a hit on the hitbox.
Tut_5_Desc: Need complex combos? Spela in your key presses, then open the Visual Timeline Redigeraor. You can drag and drop the delays perfectly to match the server's lag and your character's ASPD.
